assessment.reason: Need the transferFrom implementation to verify whether allowances can be consumed in the standard way required to substantiate an approve allowance-race finding.

assessment.explanation: The function directly replaces an existing allowance. If an owner changes a nonzero allowance, the spender can front-run the approval transaction and spend the old allowance, then spend the newly approved allowance afterward. This is the ERC-20 approval race condition.

findings.vulnerability_type: ERC-20 approval race condition / transaction-order dependence
findings.explanation: `approve` overwrites `allowance[msg.sender][_spender]` without requiring the current allowance to be zero or using an increment/decrement pattern. `transferFrom` can consume the allowance, so a spender observing an allowance reduction can use the prior allowance before the replacement and then use the new allowance.

provided_context.name: transferFrom(address,address,uint256)
